title: Explainer Videos Now Draw Real DNA Comparisons | vitalii.no
description:
Explainer videos illustrating a cast of characters or a real object had no consistent source of imagery — whatever generic icon set happened to be on hand went in. Genetics questions had no purpose-built way to show a DNA comparison, and timelines placed years as evenly spaced dots no matter how far apart the real dates actually were.

Every picture field in a video plan can now point straight at a real emoji from a licensed set of 1,595 images, checked against a signed manifest before it ever reaches the screen. A new DNA comparison effect zooms into the exact base pair that changed and carries it into the next generation; a reworked timeline now spaces dates on a real scale instead of guessing evenly.

1,595 licensed images, one verified DNA mutation per video, and timelines that finally measure real distance instead of evenly-spaced guesses.
